DEAD FREQUENCY Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 23, 2026

You play without creating an account, and your progress is stored only on your device. TeamCP runs no game servers. Achievements can optionally be synced with Google Play Games, which Google processes under your Google account. Otherwise the internet is used only to load ads, and the ad services (Unity LevelPlay and Unity Ads) process device information and advertising identifiers needed to deliver them.

Applies to version 1.0.0. We update this page and its date when features or the ad setup change.

1. Scope and operator

TeamCP develops and operates the Android game ‘DEAD FREQUENCY’ (com.teamcp.deadfrequency). This policy explains what information the game handles and the choices you have. Contact: teamcp.channel@gmail.com.

The game has no TeamCP accounts, game servers, chat or in-app purchases. The only sign-in is the optional Google Play Games sign-in (section 4). It does not ask for or collect your name, email, phone number, precise location (GPS), contacts, photos or microphone. If you email support, we use your address and message only to answer you.

2. Information stored on your device

This data is kept only in the app’s private Android storage for game features (continue, archive, new game plus) and is never sent to TeamCP. The app contains no analytics (such as Firebase Analytics) or crash-reporting tools.

  • The run in progress: day, resources, choices and the communication log (last 3 runs)
  • Archive: endings, frequencies, contacts and records you found, the date first found, and the number of completed runs
  • Which achievements you earned and which have already been sent to Google Play Games
  • Ending hint levels unlocked early with rewarded ads
  • Settings: language, text speed, sound, music, vibration, accessibility options and whether the tutorial was seen

3. Android Auto Backup

The app allows Android Auto Backup. If backup is turned on for your device, Android stores the game data above (and settings the ad SDK saved inside the app) encrypted in your Google account’s backup space, and can restore it when you reinstall the app or move to a new device.

This backup is provided by Google according to your device settings; TeamCP cannot access its contents. You can turn it off or delete it in your device’s Settings > Google > Backup.

4. Google Play Games achievements

The game offers 24 achievements through Google Play Games services. When the game starts, Google Play Games may sign you in automatically according to your Play Games settings, and you can also sign in with the achievements button on the Archive screen. Signing in is optional: if you cancel, have no Play Games profile or are offline, the whole game still works, and earned achievements are kept on the device and sent the next time you are signed in.

While you are signed in, the app sends Google only which achievements you unlocked (worked out from your archive progress on the device). Google processes your Play Games player ID, profile (gamer name and avatar) and achievement records under its own policy and shows them in Google Play Games. TeamCP does not receive your email address or name and stores no player data on any server.

5. Ads and the information ad services process

The game is free and supported by ads. The ad setup is Unity LevelPlay (mediation) and Unity Ads. It does not include AdMob, Firebase or any payment SDK.

Ads appear as a banner at the bottom of the screen (not on the start screen or in cutscenes), as full-screen ads when you end a day roughly every other in-game day and when you leave an ending result screen, and as rewarded ads (ending hints) that play only when you tap them. You can finish the whole game without watching any ad.

To load and show ads, the ad services may process:

  • IP address and the approximate region derived from it; device model, operating system, app version, language and network information
  • Advertising and SDK identifiers such as the Android advertising ID and app set ID
  • Ad requests, impressions, clicks and completed views, plus error and diagnostic information

These are used to deliver ads, limit how often they appear, measure performance, prevent fraud and diagnose problems. Whether ads are personalized and how much is processed depends on your region, device settings and the ad providers’ own rules. TeamCP does not receive individual user data from the ad services; we only see aggregated revenue and impression statistics in their dashboards.

6. Your ad choices

Your choice is stored only on your device and passed to the ad mediation service (Unity LevelPlay) as a consent signal. Outside those countries the consent screen is not shown and ads follow the rules of your region.

  • In the European Economic Area and the United Kingdom, the app asks for ad personalization consent on first launch and does not start the ad SDK until you choose. If you decline you still get the whole game, with non-personalized ads only. You can change the choice at any time in Settings > Ads > Personalised ads.
  • In Android Settings > Privacy > Ads you can reset or delete your advertising ID. Once deleted, a string of zeros is sent instead, so it cannot be used for personalized ads.
  • Use the privacy icon inside an ad, or the procedure in Unity’s policy below, to access, delete or opt out of ad data.
  • If you turn off your internet connection no ads are requested; the whole game can be played offline.

7. Third-party services and international processing

Unity LevelPlay, Unity Ads, Google Play Games services and Android (Google) services are governed by their own policies. Ad data, achievement data and backup data may be processed outside your country; recipients, locations and safeguards are described in each provider’s policy.

TeamCP does not sell your information. However, data processing in the advertising ecosystem may be classified as a ‘sale’ or ‘sharing’ under some local laws, so please also review the opt-out and rights procedures of the providers below.

Detailed notice of overseas transfers (added November 23, 2026)

Under Articles 28-8 and 30 of Korea’s Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA), we list each kind of processing in this game in which personal information is transferred outside Korea. The information below is sent directly from your device to each provider without passing through any server operated by TeamCP. Provider details are based on each provider’s published policy.

Ads — Unity LevelPlay, Unity Ads, ironSource Ads

Recipient and contact
Unity Technologies (Unity Technologies S.F.) — operator of Unity LevelPlay, Unity Ads and ironSource Ads
Contact: DPO@unity3d.com · 116 New Montgomery Street, Suite 200, San Francisco, CA 94105, United States
Destination countries
The United States, plus countries where Unity has facilities (including Israel, where ironSource is headquartered) and countries with data centers of service providers Unity uses (such as Google Cloud Platform) — as stated in Unity’s Game Player and App User Privacy Policy
Data transferred
Advertising identifiers (Google advertising ID, app set ID, etc., to the extent device settings allow), IP address and approximate location derived from it, device model, operating system, app version, language, network information, and ad request, impression, click, completed-view, error and diagnostic information (details in the ads section of this policy)
When and how
Each time the ad SDK initializes or requests, shows or measures an ad while the app is running, sent directly from your device to Unity’s servers over the internet (encrypted connection)
Purpose
Ad mediation and delivery, frequency capping, performance measurement, fraud prevention, error diagnosis
Retention period
Unity states that it keeps data for as long as needed for the processing purposes and may keep it longer when needed for legal obligations or for disputes or investigations (Unity policy section 10, “Retention”). Because Unity does not publish a fixed retention period for general ad data, this policy does not state a separate period.
Legal basis
PIPA Article 28-8(1)(iii)(a) — treated as outsourcing and storage needed to perform the contract for providing a free (ad-supported) game, with the transfer details disclosed in this policy
How to refuse and effect
If you turn off the internet connection, no ad requests or transfers take place. If you delete the advertising ID in Android settings, the advertising ID is not sent. If you do not want any transfer, you can stop using and uninstall the app; in that case you cannot use ads or ad rewards. To access or delete information already transferred, contact Unity (DPO@unity3d.com) or use the privacy icon in the ad.

Google — Google Play Games · Android Auto Backup

Recipient and contact
Google LLC
Contact: googlekrsupport@google.com · Domestic representative in Korea: Google Korea LLC (22F, 152 Teheran-ro, Gangnam-gu, Seoul · +82-2-722-7778 · data-access-requests@google.com) — as stated in Google’s “Additional privacy information for Korean residents”
Destination countries
Google data centers outside Korea (such as the United States). See Google data center locations for where they are.
Data transferred
Google Play Games: Play Games player ID, profile (gamer name and avatar), and unlocked achievements
Android Auto Backup: if backup is on in your device settings, Android sends this app’s saved data and settings to your Google account’s backup storage (nothing is sent if you turn it off in device settings).
When and how
Sent to Google over the network (encrypted connection) at the same time the information is collected, when the feature is used (per Google)
Purpose
Providing achievements, Device backup and restore
Retention period
Google account and Play Games data are kept until you delete them or for the period Google sets (“Retaining your information” in Google’s Privacy Policy).
Legal basis
PIPA Article 28-8(1)(iii)(a) — treated as outsourcing and storage needed to provide the game-linked features you choose, with the transfer details disclosed in this policy · Android Auto Backup depends on your device and Google account backup settings
How to refuse and effect
Nothing is sent if you do not sign in to Play Games, and you can use the whole game. In that case Play Games achievements are not recorded (unlock records stay on the device). You can turn off or delete backups under Android Settings > Google > Backup; in that case data is not restored automatically when you reinstall or change devices.

8. Deleting data and retention

Game data on your device stays until you delete it. Backup and ad data retention follows each provider’s policy. We do not keep support emails longer than needed after your request is resolved.

  • Game data: uninstall the app, or go to Android Settings > Apps > DEAD FREQUENCY > Storage > Clear data. This cannot be undone.
  • Android backup: turn off backup or delete the device backup in Settings > Google > Backup.
  • Google Play Games: you can delete this game’s Play Games data or your Play Games profile in Google Play Games settings (see ‘Delete Google Play Games data’ below). This does not delete your Google account.
  • Ad data: delete or reset your advertising ID and use Unity’s request procedure. Uninstalling the app alone does not delete data ad providers have already processed.
  • Need help: email teamcp.channel@gmail.com with the app name and your request. Do not send passwords or ID documents. For data TeamCP does not hold, we will point you to the right provider’s procedure.

9. Your rights

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict or object to processing, withdraw consent, opt out of sale/sharing, or complain to a supervisory authority. Because TeamCP keeps no game data on servers, most requests are handled through your device settings or the ad providers, and we will tell you which route to use.

10. Children and parents

DEAD FREQUENCY is a story game about disaster, survival and death and is not directed at children under 13. The app tells the ad services that it is not child-directed, and it has no age check or parental consent feature.

If you believe information from a child under 13 has been processed, contact us and we will explain how to delete it.

11. Security and changes

Game data is kept in the app’s private Android storage, which other apps cannot read. Ad traffic, Play Games communication and backups use each provider’s encrypted connections.

When features, SDKs or processing change, we update this policy and its date and announce important changes on this page. If you think the language versions of this document differ, please contact us.

Additional notice under Korea’s Personal Information Protection Act (added November 23, 2026)

Under Article 30 of Korea’s Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA) and Article 31 of its Enforcement Decree, this notice explains your rights and how to exercise them, children under 14 and their legal guardians, the security measures we take, and our privacy officer. It applies together with the rest of this policy.

Your rights and how to exercise them

  • You may at any time ask TeamCP to give you access to, correct, delete, or suspend the processing of the personal information it processes about you, and you may withdraw your consent (PIPA Articles 35–37).
  • How to ask: email the app name and your request to the contact below (teamcp.channel@gmail.com). Because the app has no accounts, please include information that lets TeamCP find the record (for example, the approximate date or report number of a problem report). A legal guardian or a person you authorize may also make a request; in that case we may ask for proof of that relationship.
  • Response time: we will tell you the outcome within 10 days of receiving your request. If the law gives a reason to limit or refuse the request, or we cannot complete it within that time, we will tell you why and how to object.
  • Information stored only on your device (app records, settings, and so on) is not held by TeamCP, so you can delete it yourself with the app’s delete options, by clearing the app’s storage in Android settings, or by uninstalling the app.
  • For information processed by outside providers such as the ad services and Google, you can also contact each provider at the contact listed in the overseas transfer notice above.
  • Remedies in Korea: you can apply for dispute mediation or advice to the Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee (+82-1833-6972, www.kopico.go.kr), the Personal Information Infringement Report Center (118, privacy.kisa.or.kr), the Supreme Prosecutors’ Office (1301, www.spo.go.kr), or the Korean National Police Agency (182, ecrm.police.go.kr).

Children under 14 and legal guardians

  • Korea’s Personal Information Protection Act requires the consent of a legal guardian when the personal information of a child under 14 is processed on the basis of consent (Article 22-2).
  • This app does not ask for a date of birth or age, and it has no age check or way to confirm a guardian’s consent. Because it does not treat users differently by age, the processing described in this policy also applies to users under 14. The app tells the ad services, at app level, that it is “not directed to children”. This is not the result of checking any individual user’s age.
  • Personalized ads: the in-app consent screen for personalized ads is shown only in the European Economic Area (EEA) and the UK, and not in Korea or other regions. Users under 14 should, together with a guardian, delete the advertising ID under Android Settings > Privacy > Ads so that it is not used for personalized ads.
  • Users under 14 should not include personal information such as their name or contact details in problem reports or inquiries.
  • Guardians’ rights and how to exercise them: a legal guardian may ask for access to, correction, deletion, or suspension of processing of the child’s personal information, and may withdraw consent. The method and response time are the same as in “Your rights and how to exercise them” above. We ask only for the minimum information needed to confirm guardianship and delete it once confirmed.
  • If we learn that the personal information of a child under 14 has been processed without a legal guardian’s consent, we will promptly delete that information held by TeamCP.

Security measures for personal information

  • On-device storage: app records and settings are stored in the app-private storage that Android keeps separate for each app, and are not sent to servers operated by TeamCP except as described in this policy.
  • Encrypted transmission: information the app sends over the internet (ad requests, Google services) is sent over encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
  • Data minimization: we do not collect sign-ups, passwords, names, or phone numbers, which keeps the personal information held by TeamCP to a minimum.
  • Retention and deletion: TeamCP does not run a server that receives game records; information on your device stays there until you delete it.
  • Inquiry emails are deleted once they are no longer needed after we have responded. Personal information is kept only as electronic files and is deleted when the retention period ends.
  • Security for information processed by outside providers such as the ad services and Google follows each provider’s policy.
